title: Require Generic Service Anchor Exports
forbids: an existing service spine or module composition router without the direct generic const export for its role; an elected createMiddleware factory that returns the contract implementer, constructs a second native context author, or publishes its captured author; direct middleware authorship in base.ts; an aliased runtime os import that creates another authoring name; or an untyped context root
why: Direct base, contract, service, module, and router anchors give exact authoring and composition one stable structural name. A standalone or embedded API base may expose one context-seeded native middleware author through a factory without leaking contract, router, provider, or authoring authority.
remediate: Directly export base from standalone base.ts; service from root impl.ts; contract from contract.ts; module from module.ts; and router from each root or module router.ts. Name the context type on every context root. When host projection is needed, import os once under its native name in base.ts, construct one private os.$context<CompleteInitialContext>() value, and return only that same value from createMiddleware(). Do not export the captured author or author middleware directly in base.ts. Give named router/*.router.ts leaves and subrouters domain names, then compose them in module/router.ts.
message: Each service spine file must directly export its generic local anchor.
